name: Nestlé CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Nestlé S.A. is a nutrition, health and wellness company that makes prepared dishes, cooking aids, milk-based products, baby foods, cereals, pharmaceuticals and ophthalmic goods. Its segments are the North America, Europe, Asia/Oceania/Africa, Latin America and Greater China zones, plus Nestlé Health Science and Nespresso. Henri Nestlé founded it in 1866, and it is based in Vevey, Switzerland.
